entities.name: Ibrayım Yusupov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ibroyim Yusupov was a Soviet, Karakalpak and Uzbek poet, teacher, translator and playwright. He was the People’s Poet of Uzbekistan and Karakalpakstan. He was also the Hero of Uzbekistan (2004).
